newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Mobutu to return to Zaire, official says.
newsitem.headline: Mobutu to return to Zaire, official says.

text.p: A senior official of Zaire's ruling party said on Tuesday that ailing President Mobutu Sese Seko would return home at the beginning of next week after months abroad for cancer treatment.
"He is coming back to Kinshasa at the beginning of next week and he will stay here," Mbanza Mukalayi, a vice-president of Mobutu's Popular Movement for the Revolution, told Reuters.
Earlier Radio France Internationale quoted a close aide, who is with Mobutu in France, as saying the president would come home next week after several false announcements.
Mobutu, Zaire's president of 31 years, has been convalescing in Europe for more than three months after undergoing surgery for prostate cancer in Switzerland.

During his absence, Rwandan-backed rebels have routed demoralised Zairean troops from a string of towns in the east of the country. The rebels now control large parts of North and South Kivu provinces.
In the past weeks members of the president's entourage have announced his imminent return on numerous occasions.
But after failing to arrive, many Zaireans now doubt Mobutu is well enough to make more than a token visit.
A senior official in Prime Minister Kengo wa Dondo's government said that in reality only Mobutu himself knows when he will return and whether he is fit to do so.

Zaire analysts say that apart from the limitations imposed on him by his state of health, Mobutu has been waiting for a politically convenient moment to return when he can appear to take control of the situation.
